name: Rakdos the Defiler
description: A capricious, megalomaniacal demon who has lived thousands of years and is the undisputed head of the Rakdos Cult.

timeline.summary: Rakdos, previously dumped unconscious into his lava pit, has awakened and been restored to full power.
